# WebCrawlers

> WebCrawlers gets businesses seen in AI answers. It checks how AI systems
> (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and their crawlers) read a website, fixes what
> blocks them through a safety-gated pipeline with backups and one-click undo,
> tests the real questions buyers ask AI, and reports visibility as a
> five-stage measured funnel. Unmeasurable metrics are reported as
> unmeasurable, never estimated.

Contact: hello@webcrawlers.tech

## Pages

- [Home](https://webcrawlers.tech/): the problem ("can't be seen on ChatGPT") and what WebCrawlers does about it
- [What is GEO?](https://webcrawlers.tech/what-is-geo): definition, GEO vs SEO, and the measurable inputs that influence AI citations
- [How it works](https://webcrawlers.tech/how-it-works): the ten-stage pipeline mechanism, safety gates, and funnel measurement
- [FAQ](https://webcrawlers.tech/faq): honest answers, including what nobody can promise about AI search
